# Qwen2.5-VL / Qwen3-VL vision reference fixtures

What the Rust front end (`qwen_vl_vision`, reusing `qwen35_vision`) must
reproduce for each family, generated by Hugging Face's own implementation (no
model weights): `tools/vlm_fixtures/gen_qwen_vl_fixtures.py`, transformers
5.14.1, torch 2.14.1, torchvision 0.29.1 (versions are recorded in the JSON),
against `OpenVINO/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-int4-ov` and
`OpenVINO/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-int4-ov` (configs, processor configs, chat
template and tokenizer only).

- The input images are the Qwen3.5 fixtures' PNGs (`../qwen35_vision/*.png`).
- `reference.json` `families.<qwen2_5_vl|qwen3_vl>`:
  - `processor`: the image processor constants (Qwen2.5-VL: patch 14, CLIP
    mean/std, 3136..12845056 pixels; Qwen3-VL: patch 16, mean/std 0.5,
    65536..16777216 pixels).
  - `images.<name>`: the PIL (`slow`) and torchvision (`fast`) processors'
    `grid_thw` and a summary of `pixel_values`; `big_1600x1200_maxpx262144`
    re-runs a source image under a lower budget (the antialiased kernel).
  - `prompts.<name>`: `prompt_ids` (one `<|image_pad|>` per image, as the API
    renders it), HF's expanded `input_ids`, the image sizes and grids, HF's
    3-row `position_ids` from `get_rope_index` and `rope_delta`.
  - `encoder.grids.<name>`: the vision IRs' host inputs from
    `transformers.vision_utils`: rotary table, `cu_seqlens`, and Qwen2.5-VL's
    `window_index` / `cu_window_seqlens` or Qwen3-VL's bilinear position
    indices and weights.

Against the PIL processor the Rust preprocessing is bit-identical in f32; the
torchvision processor differs by at most two 8-bit levels. Grids, ids and
positions must match exactly.
